channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Tata Trusts may urge Tata Sons to seek RBI review of public listing order before legal action
item.description: All options open, but Trusts would first want to take up the matter with RBI. Developments on the listing front have also muddled Tatas' plans to find a successor for N Chandrasekaran

item.title: Embassy Developments to double down on luxury housing, says MD Aditya Virwani
item.description: Backed by a ₹19,500-crore launch pipeline, the developer is targeting ₹8,000 crore in sales bookings for FY27.

item.title: Meta India to report child abuse material to Indian agencies
item.description: Meta will report child sexual abuse material directly to India’s cybercrime authorities, shifting from its long-standing US reporting mechanism under NCMEC.

item.title: Delhi HC orders tax dept to refund ₹783 cr to Teva Israel over Ranbaxy payment
item.description: This brings relief to Teva in a nearly nine-year-old court battle over the payments linked to erstwhile Ranbaxy, now part of Sun Pharmaceutical Industries

item.title: Oracle layoffs: ‘Some difficult news’ - Read US tech giant’s complete email to affected employees
item.description: Oracle has begun a fresh round of layoffs as it cuts jobs while ramping up spending on AI infrastructure and data centres.

item.title: Titan SKINN gets in the game for pricier perfumes
item.description: Titan sees room for SKINN to move consumers up the price ladder with the company increasing premium launches and expanding physical sampling points to drive the shift.

item.title: SC refuses to quash Delhi HC order against former NSE CEO Chitra Ramkrishna on corruption charges
item.description: Chitra Ramkrishna's plea against her prosecution under the Prevention of Corruption Act was dismissed by the Supreme Court, which stated her argument regarding public servant status can be raised at trial. The High Court's ruling was deemed correct.

item.title: Delhi High Court seeks OpenAI’s reply on ANI plea to stop ChatGPT from using its content
item.description: A division bench has asked OpenAI to respond to ANI’s appeal challenging a single-judge order that denied an injunction against ChatGPT’s use of its news content.

item.title: Air India board meets in Mumbai as Tewolde Gebremariam set to take charge, new CEO's salary structure in focus
item.description: Air India's board is meeting in Mumbai as CEO Campbell Wilson prepares to step down this month. Incoming CEO Tewolde Gebremariam is expected to take charge later this month, with the board set to discuss his salary structure and other matters.

item.title: Jefferies calls Zerodha's Nikhil Kamath ‘YouTube podcaster’, investor spots bigger shift
item.description: A Jefferies research note reportedly cited Nikhil Kamath’s WTF Podcast as a source for insights on India’s travel sector, prompting investor Rahul Mathur to highlight how YouTube is increasingly becoming a source of market intelligence.

item.title: Solar Industries expects to triple revenue in two years with $1.36 billion buyout of South Africa's Omnia
item.description: Shares of Solar Industries India tumbled by over 12% on Tuesday following the company's announcement of acquiring a 100% stake in the Johannesburg-based maker of explosives and agri-products

item.title: Flam raises $40 million in Series B led by QED Investors
item.description: The new funding will be used for research and development of Flam’s AI models, expanding its product suite and scaling enterprise sales globally.
